source: 665 Clues
target: 665 Indicia

source: If the Dream Festival has a fixed date, as I suspect, it should be one of the coming days or span a few days…
target: Si Festum Somniorum diem fixum habeat, ut suspicio, id inter dies proximos aut per aliquot dies dilatari oportet…

source: Recently, I came to Hisoka’s house every night to sleep, trying not to miss the Dream Festival.
target: Nuper, quot nocte ad domum Hisokae veni ut dormiam, ne Festum Somniorum praetermitterem…

source: I also need to figure out the basic patterns of the special dream as much as possible before it begins.
target: Etiam mihi necesse est, antequam incipiat, quam maxime cognoscere formas fundamentales somnii specialis…

source: For example, how to leave the dream normally without entering the primitive forest…
target: Exemplum gratia, quomodo somnium rite deserere possis, sine in silvam priscam ingredi…

source: Lumian closed the golden pocket watch and slipped it into the breast pocket of his shirt, concealed by his vest.
target: Lumian horologium aureum clausit et illud in sinum pectorale tunicae suae, veste celato, inseruit.

source: He didn’t continue sleeping there.
target: Ibi dormire non continuavit.

source: Instead, he chose to descend the stairs and enter the streets of Tizamo.
target: Pro re, descendere scalas et in vias Tizamo ingredi elexit.

source: First, Ludwig would have his second supper in twenty minutes.
target: Primum, Ludwig secundam cenam intra viginti minuta habebit.

source: According to their agreement, if Lumian didn’t return in time, Ludwig would come over and forcefully wake him up.
target: Ex consensu eorum, si Lumian tempore non rediret, Ludwig veniet et eum vi excitabit.

source: Second, he had to update Madam Magician on his discoveries.
target: Secundo, de inventis suis Dominae Magicae certiorem facere debebat.

source: Just as Lumian stepped out of Hisoka’s house, a voice suddenly sounded from behind.
target: Modo quo Lumian ex domo Hisokae exiverat, vox subito ex tergo resonavit.

source: “What exactly are you investigating?”
target: "Quid prorsus investigas?"

source: In a dark corner where the crimson moonlight couldn’t reach, Camus Castiya emerged, dressed in a white shirt and an unbuttoned yellow vest.
target: In obscuro angulo, ubi lumen lunaris rubri pervenire non poterat, Camus Castiya apparuit, indutus camisia alba et vestem flavam nondum alligatam.

source: His disheveled hair collapsed from staying up too late.
target: Capilli eius inordinati corruperunt ob seram vigiliam.

source: At some point, the young leader of the Port Pylos patrol team’s combat team had been waiting here.
target: Aliquando, iuvenis dux turmae pugnae manipuli speculatorum Portus Pylos hic exspectabat.

source: Lumian wasn’t surprised at all, as if he had sensed Camus’ presence.
target: Lumian omnino non miratus est, quasi praesentiam Camus percipuisset.

source: He evaded the question and said, “Many scenes display different states during the day and at night.”
target: Quaestionem evitavit et dixit: “Multae scaenae diversas formas die et nocte ostendunt.”

source: “Indeed.” Camus had dealt with numerous mystical incidents that matched this description.
target: “Certe.” Camus cum multis incidentibus mysticis, quae hanc descriptionem conveniebant, versatus est.

source: The simplest and most common situation was that certain haunted houses appeared normal under the sunlight.
target: Condicio simplicissima et communissima erat, nam quaedam domus infestatae sub sole consuete apparuerunt.

source: As Lumian walked towards the Brieu Motel, he teased Camus with a smile, “Have you been awake the entire time, squatting in the shadows outside the motel, observing my movements?
target: Dum Lumian versus Brieu Motel ambulabat, Camus risu irridens interpellavit: “Num totum tempus vigilasti, in umbris extra motel insidens, motus meos observans?

source: “That’s tough. Careful not to suddenly drop dead.”
target: “Haud facilis res est. Cave ne repente mortuus fias.”

source: If Camus hadn’t known that Louis Berry had a close relationship with the Church of The Fool and didn’t mind him tagging along, he would have thought Lumian’s teasing was a warning.
target: Si Camus nescivisset Ludovicum Berry arctim cum Ecclesia Stulti consociatum esse atque non molestum esse eum comitari, putavisset irrisionem Lumiani monitionem fuisse.

source: Do you think I want that? Camus laughed self-deprecatingly.
target: Num putas me hoc velle? Camus humiliter sua risu cachinnavit.

source: “I’ll be in charge of watching tonight. It’s Maslow or Rhea’s turn tomorrow.”
target: “Ego hanc noctem vigilandi curam suscipiam. Cras aut Maslow aut Rhea officium habebit.”

source: Lumian didn’t engage in further conversation.
target: Lumian ulteriorem sermonem non susceperat.

source: As if lost in thought, he made his way back to the Brieu Motel.
target: Velut in cogitatione immersus, iter revertere ad Brieu Motel fecit.

source: Camus wanted to inquire further, but he dared not.
target: Camus ulterius interrogare cupiebat, sed non ausus est.

source: He then saw the adventurer stop at the motel’s entrance, his back toward Camus.
target: Tum vidit viatorem ad ostium motel sisti, tergo versus Camus.

source: Lumian said calmly, “Before Twanaku died, he mentioned a term—Dream Festival.
target: Lumian tranquille dixit: “Antequam Twanaku mortuus esset, terminum commemoravit—Festum Somniorum.

source: “I’ve just discovered some traces in his house and confirmed that there’s a special dream happening in Tizamo Town.
target: “Mox vestigia in domo eius detexi et confirmavi quod somnium speciale in oppido Tizamo eveniat.

source: “Gather all the folklore related to dreams in this area and bring it to me as soon as possible.”
target: “Collige omnem traditionem de somniis huius regionis et mihi quam primum adfer.”

source: “Uh…” Camus was at a loss at first, but then his mind cleared, as if a bucket of ice‐cold water had been poured over him on a scorching summer day.
target: “Eh…” Camus primum perplexus erat, sed deinde mens eius clarificata est, velut situla aquae frigidae in aestate ardenti super eum versa fuisset.

source: As expected, there’s more to the Twanaku incident.
target: Ut expectabatur, de casu Twanaku plura sunt.

source: There’s indeed a huge problem lurking here!
target: Revera ingens quaestio hic latet!

source: Camus wasn’t too surprised, but his heart pounded.
target: Camus parum miratus est, sed cor eius vehementer pulsabat.

source: Instinctively, he replied, “Okay.”
target: Instinctive respondit: “Bene.”

source: After agreeing, Camus realized that he had unknowingly followed Lumian’s instructions, as if the other man were the captain of a patrol team.
target: Post consensu, Camus animadvertit se sublimiter praecepta Lumiani secutum esse, ac si ille vir dux turmae speculatorum esset.

source: After watching Lumian enter the Brieu Motel, Camus briefly analyzed his reaction.
target: Lumian in Brieu Motel intrantem spectato, Camus brevi tempore eius reactionem perspexit.

source: He felt that this situation stemmed from both the intimidation brought about by Lumian’s strength and the accumulated credibility and reliability of his previous deeds.
target: Sentivit hanc condicionem ex et minatione quae potentia Lumiani oriebatur, et ex auctoritate ac fidei constantia praevius factorum eius.

source: I have to send a telegram back to Port Pylos to request reinforcements…
target: Debebo telegraphem ad Portum Pylos redimittere ut subsidia petam…

source: In addition, I need to familiarize myself with Tizamo as soon as possible and strive to move jurisdiction here within a few days…
target: Praeterea, statim Tizamo cognoscere oportet mihi et contendere ut intra paucos dies hanc jurisdictionem moveam…

source: After considering his next steps, Camus let out another sigh.
target: Postquam proximas actiones contemplatus est, Camus alterum suspirium edidit.

source: Ever since encountering Louis Berry, problems had never ceased erupting!
target: Ex quo Ludovicum Berry obviam factus est, quaestiones numquam desinuerunt erumpere!

source: I initially came to Tizamo to monitor his actions and prevent any accidents.
target: Primum ad Tizamo veni ut eius actiones observarem et ullam cladem prohiberem.

source: Why am I now investigating the Dream Festival?
target: Cur nunc Festum Somniorum investigo?

source: Up in the suite on the second floor of the Brieu Motel, Lumian greeted Ludwig shuffling to the dining table, having just woken up.
target: In conclavi in secundo piano Brieu Motel, Lumian Ludovicum, qui ad mensam cenariam incedebat et modo evigilatus erat, salutavit.

source: He then returned to the master bedroom.
target: Tum ad cubiculum principale rediit.

source: Before pondering his letter to Madam Magician, Lumian noticed a folded square of paper on the desk.
target: Antequam de epistola ad Dominam Magicam meditabatur, Lumian quadratum papyrum plicatum in mensa animadvertit.

source: A reply after midnight—so typical of Madam Magician, he thought with an inward chuckle.
target: Responsum post mediam noctem—tantum typicum Dominae Magicae, cogitavit, subrisu interiori.

source: He picked up the letter and conjured a blazing white fireball above his head for light, as Tizamo lacked gas lighting.
target: Epistolam sustulit et globum ignis candidi ardentis super caput suum evocavit ad lucem, cum Tizamo lucernam gasi non haberet.

source: Under the fireball’s incandescent glow, Lumian unfolded and read the letter:
target: Sub fulgore incandescente globi ignis, Lumian evolvit epistolam et legit:

source: “I’ve completed my astromancy and received a revelation about the rest of the Abscessed Hand’s body.
target: “Astromantiam meam perfeci et revelationem de reliquo corpore Manus Abscessae accepi.

source: “The remaining body is divided into three parts.
target: “Reliquum corpus in tres partes dividitur.

source: One part is highly suspected to be located in the Underworld, and the other two parts have hints closely related to Lenburg’s capital, Azshara, but they’re not actually there.
target: Una pars vehementer suspicatur in Inferis situm esse, et duae partes alterae indicia habent arcte coniuncta cum capite Lenburgi, Azshara, sed vere ibi non adsunt.

source: My interpretation is that the two missing body parts of the Abscessed Hand are hidden away in the City of Exiles, Morora.
target: Interpretatio mea est duas partes corporea Manus Abscessae, quae desunt, in Urbe Exilium, Morora, absconditas esse.

source: “Don’t you find it too coincidental?
target: “Nonne hoc nimis fortuitum tibi videtur?

source: “No, it’s not a coincidence at all. My astromancy results show that nearly three months ago, one of the two body parts was still located in the tombs of the Paz Kingdom in the Southern Continent, and the other part was related to some folklore in the south-central region.
target: “Minime, omnino non est casus. Resultata astromantiae meae ostendunt paene tribus mensibus abhinc, unam ex duabus partibus corporis adhuc in sepulcris regni Paz in Continente Australi sitam fuisse, et alteram partem cum nonnullo fabularum genere in regione meridie centrali coniunctam esse.

source: “Get my drift?
target: “Capisne quid dicerer?

source: Wh— Almost three months ago… As a Conspirer, Lumian grasped Madam Magician’s implication.
target: Heu— paene tribus mensibus abhinc… Ut conspirator, Lumian implicationem Dominae Magicae comprehendi sensit.

source: Accepting the information about the most terrifying Sealed Artifact 0-01, and masquerading as Ludwig’s godfather, was akin to accepting an olive branch offered from the Church of Knowledge.
target: Acceptare informationem de terribili Artefacta Sigillata 0-01, et simul gerere se quasi patrus Ludovici, simile erat accipere ramum oleae a Ecclesia Cognitionis oblato.

source: Lumian had promised to pay a certain price for this knowledge…
target: Lumian promisit pretium aliquod pro hac scientia solvendum esse…

source: It seemed the Church of Knowledge then dispatched high-ranking individuals to gather the two remaining body parts of the Abscessed Hand and hide them away in the City of Exiles, Morora.
target: Videtur Ecclesia Cognitionis deinde homines praestantes misisse, ut duas reliquas partes corporis Manus Abscessae collexerent et in Urbe Exilium, Morora, absconderent.

source: What does this mean?
target: Quid hoc significat?

source: It is clearly forcing me to journey to Morora, unless I choose to abandon my hopes of advancing to Sequence 4 and achieving the state of demi-godhood.
target: Manifestum est me iter facere ad Mororam coactum esse, nisi optio relinquendi spes meas ad Sequenciam IV progrediendi ac ad statum semidei adipiscendi surgerit.

source: Heh heh, my agreement with the Abscessed Hand stated that until I found its full body, I would never be able to obtain true godhood.
target: Heh heh, pactum meum cum Manus Abscessae dicebat, quod nisi totum eius corpus invenirem, numquam veram deitatem adipiscerer.

source: This blocks any idea of trying to become a demigod without consuming potions by relying on boons instead…
target: Hoc impediat ullam ideam de semideo fieri sine potionibus sumptis, sed potius bonis inniti…

source: Thankfully, Lumian wasn’t resistant to the idea of visiting the City of Exiles, Morora, before becoming a demigod.
target: Fortunate, Lumian notioni visitandi Urbem Exilium, Mororam, antequam semideus fieret, non opponebat.

source: At that moment, he didn’t feel stifled or vexed by this necessity.
target: Illo momento, non sensit se suffocari aut vexari hac necessitate.

source: Instead, he felt it would actually save him a lot of trouble.
target: Proinde sensit eum revera multum incommoda servaturum esse.

source: After some thought, he continued reading the rest of the letter:
target: Postquam aliquantum meditatus est, reliquam epistolae partem legit.

source: “My astromancy results also tell me that once the Abscessed Hand’s full body is gathered and reunited, something extremely dangerous will happen.
target: “Resultata etiam astromantiae meae mihi narrant, quod, cum corpus integrum Manus Abscessae congregatum atque reunitum erit, aliquid periculosum eveniet.

source: It’s best to complete this reunion step while you’re in the City of Exiles, and use the existence of 0-01 to try to counteract this incoming risk.
target: Optime est hunc gradum reunionis conficere dum in Urbe Exilium es, et existentiam 0-01 adhibere ut hanc imminentem periculum compenses.

source: In other words, you need to find and retrieve the body part located in the Underworld first.
target: Aliter dicendum, oportet primum partem corporis in Inferis sitam invenire et recuperare.

source: “Yes, you should have an opportunity to enter the Underworld itself within the next three months.
target: “Etiam, habebis occasionem ipse in Inferos intrandi intra proximos tres menses.

source: Remember to seize this opportunity when it arises.
target: Memento hanc occasionem cape cum oritur.

source: Don’t ask me what opportunity it is exactly—I don’t know the specifics either.”
target: Noli me rogare quae illa occasio exacte sit—nec ego particularia sciam.

source: Opportunity to enter the Underworld within the next three months… Lumian repeated this crucial piece of information to himself.
target: Occasio ad intrandum in Inferos intra tres menses… Lumian hanc notabilem informationem sibi repetivit.

source: Amidst his elation, the words struck Lumian as peculiar.
target: Inter laetitiam suam, verba Lumian quasi insolita apparuerunt.

source: “Entering the Underworld” and “going to hell” were two distinct phrases that conveyed the same meaning.
target: “Intrare in Inferos” et “ire ad inferos” erant duo distincta verba, quae eandem significationem tradebant.

source: In this world, barring a small number of individuals, no one could readily accept the phrase “you have a chance to go to hell within three months.”
target: In hoc mundo, nisi pauci, nemo facile locutionem “habes occasionem ad inferos iturus intra tres menses” accipere poterat.

source: It was worth noting that many people would curse at each other, saying, “I wish you a swift descent into hell.”
target: Notandum est multos inter se maledicere, dicentes: “Velim tibi rapidum descensum ad inferos.”

source: For the moment, Lumian didn’t have time to ponder the opportunity to enter the Underworld.
target: Nunc, Lumian temporis non habebat sufficiens ut rem occasionis intrandi in Inferos meditaret.

source: He burned Madam Magician’s reply and jotted down his gains for the night and his guesses about the Dream Festival.
target: Dominae Magicae responsum combussit et utilitates nocturnas ac coniecturas de Festo Somniorum scribens notavit.

source: He planned to send it to the Major Arcana card holder at noon the following day.
target: Cogitavit id mittere possessori cartarum Major Arcana ad meridiem crastinae diei.

source: Although he couldn’t shake the feeling that Madam Magician’s “schedule” bore a resemblance to Franca’s, he wasn’t sure if it was convenient to send a letter at that time.
target: Quamquam sensum non potuit excludere, quod "tempus" Dominae Magicae ad Francam simile videbatur, non certo sciebat an illo tempore epistola mittere opportunum esset.

source: Northern Continent, Trier.
target: Continens Septentrionalis, Trier.

source: Winter sunlight poured through the glass, filling the living room with warmth that chased away the chill.
target: Luminum hyemalis per vitrum effudit, conclave calore replens, quod frigus expulit.

source: Franca lounged in the recliner, basking in the cozy glow with half-lidded eyes.
target: Franca in lectulo se recubuit, lumine amoeno fruens cum oculis semiobliquis.

source: Suddenly, she sensed something and sat upright, pulling her legs in.
target: Subito aliquid sensit et subito se erexit, crura comprimens.

source: In the shadowy corner, a human skull made of pure glowing silver emerged.
target: In angulo umbrato, calvaria humana ex puro argento lucente emersit.

source: Pale white flames flickered in its vacant sockets.
target: Flammae pallidae albae in subtilibus orbitis eius vacuis micabant.

source: Madame Hela’s messenger… Why is she contacting me?
target: Nuntia Dominae Helae… Cur me contingit?

source: Franca watched, puzzled, as the skull’s jaws unhinged, releasing a single page that drifted towards her.
target: Franca spectabat, perplexa, dum mandibulae calvariae disiectae erant, dimittens unam paginam quae ad eam undulabat.

source: She snatched the letter and scanned it quickly.
target: Epistolam rapuit et celeriter perlegit.

source: “007 hasn’t heard from you in four days. He wants to confirm you’re okay.”
target: “007 te per quattuor dies non audivit. Vult certiorem fieri te esse incolumem.”

source: Four days without checking the group… A dry chuckle escaped her lips.
target: Quattuor dies sine coetu inspiciendo… Risu arido ex labiis eius effugit.

source: What does this mean?
target: Quid hoc significat?

source: Early to bed and late to rise keeps the king fit to rule his realm! No more morning courts!
target: Mane ad lectum et tarde surgere regit regi aptum, ut suum regnum imperet! Non amplius curiae matutinae!

source: In the early morning hours, Franca manned the radio transceiver while Jenna roamed outside, seizing her opportunity to act as a Witch.
target: In horis matutinis, Franca radiophonicam stationem tenebat, dum Jenna foris vagabatur, suam occasionem strigae esse capiens.

source: Tap tap tap! Her first telegram in days.
target: Toc, toc, toc! Prima telegraphia eius post multos dies.

source: “Shurima! Your emperor has returned!”
target: “Shurima! Imperator tuus rediit!”

source: Before long, 007’s telegram was tapped out by the analyzer-powered mechanical typewriter.
target: Mox telegraphia 007 ab typographeia mechanica, potestate analisatori imbuenta, confecta est.

source: “Hidden Blade, where have you been?”
target: “Lamina Occulta, ubi fuisti?”

source: Ahem. Franca cleared her throat.
target: Ahem. Franca guttur suum expurgavit.

source: “Late nights breed ill health. Have you no loved ones?”
target: “Noctes serae salutem male afferunt. Nonne carissimos habes?”

source: “Don’t bring up such sad topics…”
target: “Noli talia tristia argumenta evocare…”

source: “Hidden Blade, have you mastered the assassination arts—
target: “Lamina Occulta, num artem occultam caedendi didicisti—

source: sundering heart and soul?”
target: rumpere cor et animam?”

source: Protests arose from the other members.
target: Protestationes a ceteris membris oruerunt.

source: At length, 007’s message arrived.
target: Denique, nuntius 007 pervenit.

source: “I have the intel on the last incident. Let’s meet to discuss.
target: “Cognitionem habeo de ultimo casu. Conveniamus ut disseramus.

source: The higher-ups also approved the item swap for the story you proposed.”
target: Superiores quoque permutationem rerum pro fabula quam proposuisti approbaverunt.

source: Franca blinked, startled.
target: Franca palpebravit, obstupescens.

source: “How long did that take? I’d forgotten all about it…”
target: “Quantum temporis id cepit? Omnia de eo obliviscitus eram…”

source: After all, understanding that humanoid Sealed Artifact’s tale was Lumian’s curiosity, not hers.
target: Postremo, intellegere fabulam de Artefacto Sigillato humanoideo erat curiositas Lumiani, non eius.

source: 007’s resigned telegram:
target: Telegraphium resignatum 007:

source: “Bureaucracy inertia. Unavoidable for any large, established organization.”
target: “Inertiam bureaucratiae. Ineluctabile pro qualibet magna, constituta organizatione.”

source: “Tell me about it!” Another member, Moon King’s amused agreement clattered out.
target: “Narra mihi!” Exclamavit alius membrum, rege Lunae, ridens consensu.

source: “Whether public or secret, they’re all bound by red tape.”
target: “Sive publicae sive secretæ, omnes vincuntur vinculis rubris.”

source: After arranging to meet 007 that night with the Moran Avigny intel and initial assassination plan, Franca rose with a stretch.
target: Postquam conventum cum 007 illa nocte, cum intellegentia de Moran Avigny et consilio initio caedis dispositum, Franca surrexit cum elongatione.

source: She jotted down the two tasks before performing a ritual to summon Lumian’s messenger, Penitent Baynfel.
target: Duas munera annotavit antequam ritum ad evocandum nuntium Lumiani, Penitentem Baynfel, perficeret.

source: Southern Continent, Tizamo Town.
target: Continens Australis, Oppidum Tizamo.

source: Lumian was just about to head to Hisoka’s house for a nap when his messenger materialized from the shadows, delivering a letter.
target: Lumian iam se ad domum Hisokae ad quiescendum petere parabat, cum nuntius eius e umbris apparuit atque epistolam tradidit.

source: After taking the note, Lumian noticed Penitent Baynfel didn’t immediately depart back to the spirit world as usual.
target: Postquam notam accepit, Lumian animadvertit Penitentem Baynfel non statim, ut solito, in mundum spirituum discessurum.

source: Instead, he lingered, surveying their surroundings with a measured gaze.
target: Proinde manebat, circumstantias cum oculo temperato perscrutans.
